goal.en: Build the word you need from the word you know, and stop confusing the pairs that look alike.
goal.ar: أن تشتق الكلمة التي تحتاجها من كلمة تعرفها، وأن تكفّ عن الخلط بين المتشابهات.

text.en: The slot in the sentence decides the form you need. After “a/an/the” or an adjective, you need a noun; after “be” or before a noun, you need an adjective.
text.ar: موضع الكلمة في الجملة هو ما يحدد صيغتها. فبعد a/the أو بعد صفة نحتاج اسماً، وبعد فعل الكون أو قبل الاسم نحتاج صفة.

text.en: Watch the spelling shifts: succeed → success (one c, two s), analyse → analysis, maintain → maintenance.
text.ar: انتبه لتغيّر الهجاء: succeed تصير success، وanalyse تصير analysis، وmaintain تصير maintenance.

text.en: The negative prefix is fixed by the word, not by a rule you can apply: it is “impossible” but “unlikely”, “irregular” but “inaccurate”. Learn each one with its word.
text.ar: السابقة النافية مرتبطة بالكلمة نفسها لا بقاعدة عامة: نقول impossible وunlikely، وirregular وinaccurate. فاحفظ السابقة مع كلمتها.

head: Word
Means
Example
rows: The delay had a bad effect.

text.en: Also: “advice” is the noun and “advise” the verb; “practice” is the noun and “practise” the verb in British English.
text.ar: كذلك: advice اسم وadvise فعل، وفي البريطانية practice اسم وpractise فعل.

prompt.en: Complete with the noun from “decide”: “It was a difficult ___ to make.”
prompt.ar: أكمل بالاسم المشتق من decide: It was a difficult ___ to make.

explanation.en: After “a difficult” the slot needs a noun.
explanation.ar: بعد a difficult يحتاج الموضع إلى اسم.

prompt.en: Complete with the adjective from “compete”: “The market is highly ___ .”
prompt.ar: أكمل بالصفة المشتقة من compete: The market is highly ___

explanation.en: After “is highly” the slot needs an adjective.
explanation.ar: بعد is highly يحتاج الموضع إلى صفة.

questions.sentence: Her ___ of the data was thorough and convincing.

explanation.en: After the possessive “her” the slot needs a noun: analysis.
explanation.ar: بعد ضمير الملكية her يحتاج الموضع إلى اسم: analysis.

options: The project was a great successful for us.
The project was very successful this year.
The project succeeded beyond all our hopes.
The project's success surprised everyone here.

explanation.en: After “a great” the slot needs a noun: “a great success”. “Successful” is the adjective and cannot follow an article.
explanation.ar: بعد a great يحتاج الموضع إلى اسم: a great success. أما successful فصفة ولا تأتي بعد أداة النكرة.

commonMistake.en: Both words exist and both are common, so the ear does not catch it. Check the slot: article + adjective + noun.
commonMistake.ar: الكلمتان موجودتان وشائعتان، فلا تلتقط الأذن الخطأ. تحقّق من الموضع: أداة ثم صفة ثم اسم.

questions.sentence: That figure is ___ — the real total is much higher.

explanation.en: “Accurate” takes “in-”. The prefix is fixed by the word, not by a rule.
explanation.ar: كلمة accurate تأخذ in-، والسابقة مرتبطة بالكلمة نفسها لا بقاعدة عامة.

questions.sentence: I think you have ___ what I meant — I wasn't complaining.

explanation.ar: السابقة mis- تعني «على نحو خاطئ»، أي أن الفهم وقع خطأ.

prompt.en: Match the prefix with its meaning.

explanation.en: Prefixes change meaning; suffixes change word class. Both are how English builds vocabulary.
explanation.ar: السوابق تغيّر المعنى، واللواحق تغيّر نوع الكلمة، وبهما تبني الإنجليزية مفرداتها.

questions.sentence: The committee decided to ___ the proposal after the new figures arrived.

explanation.en: “Re-” means to do it again — to look at it a second time.
explanation.ar: السابقة re- تعني إعادة الفعل، أي النظر فيه مرة أخرى.

questions.sentence: The strike will ___ deliveries across the whole region.

explanation.en: A verb is needed here: “affect” = to influence. “Effect” is the noun.
explanation.ar: الموضع يحتاج فعلاً: affect بمعنى «يؤثر في»، أما effect فاسم.

questions.sentence: The new rules had little ___ on the number of accidents.

explanation.en: After “little” a noun is needed: effect.
explanation.ar: بعد little يحتاج الموضع إلى اسم: effect.

prompt.en: Which sentence describes a car that uses little fuel?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تصف سيارة قليلة استهلاك الوقود؟

options: It is a very economical car.
It is a very economic car.
It is a very economy car indeed.
It is a very economics car.

explanation.en: “Economical” means not wasteful; “economic” relates to the economy.
explanation.ar: economical تعني «غير مبذّر»، أما economic فتتعلق بالاقتصاد.

options: Can you advice me on this matter?
Can you advise me on this matter?
She advised us to wait a week.

explanation.en: “Advice” is the noun; the verb is “advise”.

prompt.en: Which sentence describes information that must be protected?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تصف معلومات يجب حمايتها؟

explanation.en: “Sensitive” = easily affected or needing care; “sensible” = showing good judgement.

prompt.en: Complete with the noun from “maintain”: “The ___ of the building costs a fortune.”
prompt.ar: أكمل بالاسم المشتق من maintain: The ___ of the building costs a fortune.

explanation.en: maintain → maintenance. The spelling changes, which is why it is worth learning as a pair.
explanation.ar: من maintain نشتق maintenance، والهجاء يتغير، ولذلك يُحفظ الزوجان معاً.

questions.sentence: Their ___ on a single supplier makes the business ___ .

explanation.en: After “their” a noun is needed, and after “makes the business” an adjective.
explanation.ar: بعد their يحتاج الموضع اسماً، وبعد makes the business يحتاج صفة.
